description: This file defines a React component called MarkdownPreviewPlugin, which integrates with the Lexical editor to generate and display Markdown content. It manages editor updates to convert the editor's root content into Markdown, then updates the root with a code node containing the Markdown string, and calls a callback with the Markdown output.

methods.name: MarkdownPreviewPlugin
methods.description: React functional component that integrates Lexical editor to generate and display Markdown, and invokes a callback with the Markdown string.
